metadata.purpose: Document ripple changes to resolve conflicts and maintain consistency

content.rippleSummary: Resolved write order conflict with surrealdb-primary-redis-cache specification by enforcing SurrealDB-first write pattern in Gap 3 implementation. Updated _store_results() to write to SurrealDB BEFORE Redis, with timing instrumentation and graceful error handling.

componentsUpdated.changeMade: Reordered write operations: SurrealDB write FIRST (lines 222-268), Redis write SECOND (lines 270-289). Added timing instrumentation and logging to verify write order compliance.
componentsUpdated.reason: Resolve write order conflict with surrealdb-primary-redis-cache specification. SurrealDB is the source of truth and must be written before Redis cache to ensure data durability during failures.

impactAnalysis.blastRadius: LOW - internal reordering only, no API changes
benefits: Ensures data durability - SurrealDB persists before cache
Prevents cache inconsistency during SurrealDB failures
risks: If SurrealDB is slow, Redis write is delayed

keyChanges: Moved SurrealDB persistence block to execute FIRST (line 222)
Added surrealdb_write_success flag to track success
Moved Redis write to execute SECOND (line 270)
Added [REDIS-SECOND] log prefix with surrealdb_success flag
Made Redis failure non-fatal (SurrealDB is source of truth)
